description: Put a result of a person's own work into their Vibe chats: OpenVibe.Actor posts each finished run of one of their OpenVibe Agents (one chat per agent, named after it) as Vibe's message, so each run is a chat they can open and continue. No AI answer is made and nothing counts against their allowance. Loopback only, first-party service token; never granted to an app or delegated to an agent.
